verdict.rationale: GitLab describes itself as a Git-based platform with a 'Work with the Git version control system' docs section. It documents SSH keys and personal access tokens, the standard credentials for SSH and HTTPS Git access. Community users describe routinely pushing code to it; one complaint about slow pushes concerns performance, not whether the capability exists. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of clone/pull/push over HTTPS and SSH URLs with standard Git clients (evidence is mostly section headings), independent hands-on corroboration of both transports
